method.elevation: Terrarium z13 (~19 m/px), value at each H3 res-8 area's centre
method.rel_to_surroundings_m: area elevation minus the mean of its 2-ring neighbours (negative = sits lower)
method.flow: D8 flow accumulation on a 4x-downsampled DEM (~76 m cells); max upstream count within ~150 m of the area centre
method.percentiles: share of the city's 591 areas that are lower (elev_pct) / carry less flow (flow_pct)
method.adapted_from: Jal Drishti src/terrain_analyzer.py (flow accumulation / terrain analysis)
